summary: Prepare opt-in transactional old/new capture for collection source adapters without activating production readers.

replay.detail: No source scan, replay, backfill or automatic recovery. Populated sources and changed identities remain unqualified until explicit certified installation.

schema.detail: Only explicit store::collection_ivm::install creates st3_ivm_capture_state, st3_ivm_capture, st3_ivm_insert_before and selected-source triggers. Ordinary Store opens install none; no numeric database schema version changes.

rules.detail: No projection digest, claim registry or rule changes.

compatibility.detail: No collection protocol, client schema, generated client or default reader changes. Supported explicit capture schemas retain all columns and the full primary key; alternate unique aliases and virtual/expression keys remain unqualified.

downtime.detail: No default startup or activation work beyond normal deployment restart. Capture installation is explicit and independent of existing production readers.

manual.detail: No default deployment action. Source owners must prove schema, transaction-start/precommit coverage, canonical/local dependencies, bypass fencing and namespace publication before any production registration.

recovery.detail: Persisted explicit capture gaps survive reopen and cannot be acknowledged away. This preparation patch does not implement replacement serving lifetimes or guard raw/old-writer commits; such sources must remain unavailable until qualified.
